verdict.rationale: Snyk's DeepCode AI feeds context-aware risk scoring (package popularity, reachability, exploit maturity) that ranks findings into a single risk score, which gives AI-assisted prioritization. Agents can also pull Snyk scan results via the MCP server with natural-language prompts. Source-to-sink flow views help explain issues, but nothing shows they are AI-generated, and suppression is a manual ignore. Missing for 10: AI-generated explanations of findings, AI deduplication of findings, AI flagging of likely false positives, independent corroboration of AI triage quality.
